```{r setup}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| error: false
#| results: 'hide'

# Load dashboardr (includes dplyr, highcharter as dependencies)
library(dashboardr)

# Global chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  error = FALSE,
  fig.width = 12,
  fig.height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)

# Bundle loader — reads the RDS bundle once, then extracts datasets by key
.load_bundle <- function(bundle_file, key) {
  if (!exists('.dashboardr_bundle_cache', inherits = FALSE))
    .dashboardr_bundle_cache <<- list()
  if (is.null(.dashboardr_bundle_cache[[bundle_file]]))
    .dashboardr_bundle_cache[[bundle_file]] <<- readRDS(bundle_file)
  if (!(key %in% names(.dashboardr_bundle_cache[[bundle_file]])))
    stop("Bundle key '", key, "' not found in ", bundle_file, call. = FALSE)
  .dashboardr_bundle_cache[[bundle_file]][[key]]
}

# Load multiple datasets

# Load wp2
wp2 <- .load_bundle('dashboard_data_bundle.rds', 'wp2_151obs.rds')
cat('wp2 loaded:', nrow(wp2), 'rows,', ncol(wp2), 'columns\n')

# Load domains_long
domains_long <- .load_bundle('dashboard_data_bundle.rds', 'domains_long_330obs.rds')
cat('domains_long loaded:', nrow(domains_long), 'rows,', ncol(domains_long), 'columns\n')

# Load problems_long
problems_long <- .load_bundle('dashboard_data_bundle.rds', 'problems_long_236obs.rds')
cat('problems_long loaded:', nrow(problems_long), 'rows,', ncol(problems_long), 'columns\n')

# Load outcomes_long
outcomes_long <- .load_bundle('dashboard_data_bundle.rds', 'outcomes_long_235obs.rds')
cat('outcomes_long loaded:', nrow(outcomes_long), 'rows,', ncol(outcomes_long), 'columns\n')

# Load problems_report
problems_report <- .load_bundle('dashboard_data_bundle.rds', 'problems_report_6obs.rds')
cat('problems_report loaded:', nrow(problems_report), 'rows,', ncol(problems_report), 'columns\n')

# Load outcomes_report
outcomes_report <- .load_bundle('dashboard_data_bundle.rds', 'outcomes_report_7obs.rds')
cat('outcomes_report loaded:', nrow(outcomes_report), 'rows,', ncol(outcomes_report), 'columns\n')

# Load runtime_report
runtime_report <- .load_bundle('dashboard_data_bundle.rds', 'runtime_report_4obs.rds')
cat('runtime_report loaded:', nrow(runtime_report), 'rows,', ncol(runtime_report), 'columns\n')

```

## Knowledge, skills and behaviour


Because digital citizenship comprises knowledge, skills and behaviour, we coded to what extent interventions targeted these three competencies. **95%** targeted knowledge, **58%** targeted skills and only **16%** directly targeted behaviour.

An intervention was coded as targeting behaviour only if behavioural change was *directly* implemented as part of the intervention. Interventions that merely informed about behaviour were coded as *indirect*; this was the case for 66% of the interventions. In the chart, *Yes* for behaviour therefore means *directly* targeting behavioural change.


::: {.panel-tabset}

### {{< iconify ph users-fill >}} Overall


```{r comp-overall}
# Interventions targeting knowledge, skills and behaviour
result <- viz_stackedbars(
  data = wp2 %>% tidyr::drop_na(knowledge_lab, skills_lab, behavior_lab),
  title = "Interventions targeting knowledge, skills and behaviour",
  x_vars = c("knowledge_lab", "skills_lab", "behavior_lab"),
  x_var_labels = c("Knowledge", "Skills", "Behaviour"),
  stacked_type = "percent",
  horizontal = TRUE,
  stack_order = c("Yes", "Indirect", "No"),
  color_palette = c("#3D7271", "#F5D76E", "#E28D50"),
  x_label = "",
  stack_label = "Does the intervention target this competency?"
)

# Set chart height
if (inherits(result, 'highchart')) {
  result <- highcharter::hc_size(result, height = 390)
}

# Force container height with explicit wrapper
result <- htmltools::div(
  style = 'height: 390px !important; min-height: 390px !important; width: 100%; overflow: visible;',
  result
)

result
```

## Active and responsible participation


**Active participation** was stimulated when citizens learn to meaningfully engage in key life domains such as work or digital government via digital media, tools or technologies. This was encouraged by about half of the interventions (50%).

**Responsible participation** refers to an ethical use of digital media that reduces harm to oneself or others, for example by informing citizens about false information, online etiquette or protection against cybercrime. This was encouraged by the majority of interventions (81%).


::: {.panel-tabset}

### {{< iconify ph users-fill >}} Overall


```{r part-overall}
# Interventions encouraging active and responsible participation
result <- viz_stackedbars(
  data = wp2 %>% tidyr::drop_na(active_lab, responsible_lab),
  title = "Interventions encouraging active and responsible participation",
  x_vars = c("active_lab", "responsible_lab"),
  x_var_labels = c("Active participation", "Responsible participation"),
  stacked_type = "percent",
  horizontal = TRUE,
  stack_order = c("Yes", "No"),
  color_palette = c("#3D7271", "#E28D50"),
  x_label = "",
  stack_label = "Does the intervention encourage this form of participation?"
)

# Set chart height
if (inherits(result, 'highchart')) {
  result <- highcharter::hc_size(result, height = 300)
}

# Force container height with explicit wrapper
result <- htmltools::div(
  style = 'height: 300px !important; min-height: 300px !important; width: 100%; overflow: visible;',
  result
)

result
```
